title: Vectors
author: oA7a2DXCeN3DLamvj
chapter_outcomes: Recognise, describe and draw the following transformations: Reflection of a shape in a straight line, Rotation of a shape about a centre through multiples of 90°, Enlargement of a shape from a centre by a scale factor, Translation of a shape by a vector.
Describe a translation using a vector represented by (x/y), AB or a.
Multiply a vector by a scalar.
Calculate the magnitude of a vector (x/y) as √(x² + y²).
Represent vectors by directed line segments.
Use the sum and difference of two or more vectors to express given vectors in terms of two coplanar vectors.
Use vectors to reason and to solve geometric problems.

module_metadata.authors: Disha Garg, Mohammad Aslam & Sagnik Pal
